detail.title: Handling device for a flat piece
detail.abstract: The invention relates to a handling device (100) for presenting a flat piece (110) to at least a first (140) and a second treatment device (150), in particular for presenting a plastic card substrate (110) to a printer device (140) and a flipping device (150). The handling device (100) comprises an elongated backbone element (112); wherein the backbone element (112) is rotatable along a longitudinal axis (LA) and has at least a first and a second angular position; a holding element (114), configured to hold the flat piece (110) relative to the backbone element (112); and a control unit (120), configured to control the angular position of the backbone element (112); wherein, when the backbone element (112) is at the first angular position, the flat piece is at a first treatment position (142) for the first treatment device (140); and, when the backbone element (112) is at the second angular position, the flat piece (110) is at a second treatment position (152) for the second treatment device (150). Also, the invention relates to a system for treating flat pieces (110), in particular for printing on plastic card substrates (110); and a method for operating the handling device (100). Furthermore, it relates to a device (300) for presenting a flat piece (310) to at least a first treatment device, in particular for presenting a plastic card substrate (310) to a printer device.
